note: Catalogue of every shuttle and fighter type, for pre-game use: fleet building, force
legality by year, and pickers. The live objects are Java classes in com.sfb.objects.shuttles;
this file is what the game consults BEFORE a shuttle exists.
type      the key used by a ship's shuttleBays list and by the ShuttleBay factory
kind      fighter = bought with BPV, added to the carrier's cost
shuttle = carried at no cost
Suicide shuttles, scatter-packs and wild weasels are deliberately NOT here. They are roles
an admin shuttle takes on, not types anyone buys or stocks; CoiLoadout prices those
conversions in Commander's Option points at setup.
factions  which factions may field it; ["any"] = all of them
year      first year of service; 0 = always available
bpv       purchase cost; absent for anything not bought with BPV
BPV here must match what the Java class constructs — ShuttleCatalogTest pins the two.
shortName        what a launched shuttle is called: "<Ship>-<shortName>-<n>". It names
the CRAFT, never the role — an admin shuttle, a suicide shuttle and a
scatter pack built from one all read "Admin", so an opponent cannot
tell which is which. Fighters keep their own names.
canWeasel        J3.18 — any non-fighter shuttle may be charged as a Wild Weasel;
fighters never may (J4.41).
canSuicide       J2.222 — admin, minesweeping, MRS, SWAC and minelaying shuttles may
be armed as suicide shuttles; fighters, HTS and GAS may not.
scatterPackSize  FD7.11 — rack spaces of drones it may carry as a scatter pack;
0 = not a qualified shuttle. Only admin, MRS, MLS, MSS and FIGHTERS
qualify, so this list is NOT the same as canWeasel: a GAS may weasel
but not scatter-pack, and a fighter is the other way round. That is
why both are data rather than one "special shuttle" flag.
FD7.21 — an admin shuttle carries six; other types more or fewer
by their own rules (an MRS could carry eight).
FD7.211 — a FIGHTER carries up to its NORMAL load of drones, so this
must equal its drone rail count: zero for the fusion-armed Hydran
stingers, two for the Kzinti attack shuttles. ShuttleRoleEligibility
pins the two together so they cannot drift.
SPLIT BY FACTION 2026-10-06. This file carries the shared documentation and the craft any
faction may field; each empire's own shuttles and fighter lines are in <faction>.json
beside it. ShuttleCatalog.loadAll walks this directory and every file adds to ONE
registry, so a type key must be unique across the WHOLE FOLDER — a second file claiming
a key would otherwise silently replace the first, which is how a Hydran hull once
vanished from the ship library. ShuttleCatalogSplitTest fails the build on a duplicate.
fighterLinesNote: J4.4: which fighter fills each role in a carrier's bay is decided by the YEAR, not by the ship. A carrier declares how many of each role it carries (see a ship file's shuttleBays.fighters) and the latest entry whose 'from' year has arrived supplies the types. A role this era has no type for falls back to 'standard' - which is how a Hydran RN carries nine Stinger-1s in Y134 and six Stinger-2s, two Stinger-Hs and one Stinger-E in Y170 from one declaration.
